premises.text: Small and medium businesses struggle to understand and make good energy decisions due to overwhelming energy data.
premises.evidence_span: Businesses are surrounded by energy data, but few of them use it.

premises.text: Energy bills contain multiple pieces of information that can help businesses understand their usage and spending.
premises.evidence_span: his energy bill actually contains over 30 unique pieces of information, which can help him understand what he's using and what he's spending.

premises.text: Consultants provide energy reports that often go unused, leading to recurring issues with energy costs.
premises.evidence_span: the report sits on a shelf, and then 12 months later, his energy costs have gone up, and he's back to square one.

premises.text: Energy is a significant cost for small and medium businesses, leading to missed savings opportunities.
premises.evidence_span: Energy is one of the top costs for small and medium businesses.

premises.text: Energy data analytics can help businesses visualize and analyze their energy data to make better decisions.
premises.evidence_span: Energy Alpha solves this problem by helping businesses build, visualize, and analyze their energy data.

premises.text: External data sources can enhance energy analysis by providing benchmarks for performance.
premises.evidence_span: We combine Sean's data with external data sources, to show him how he's performing against the best-in-class.

premises.text: Smart meters and new legislation will increase the availability of energy data and the need for energy certificates.
premises.evidence_span: with the rollout of smart meters, even larger data sets are going to become available.

premises.text: Energy Elephant offers a free system for users to analyze their energy bills.
premises.evidence_span: Anybody can use the Energy Elephant system for free, if they have an energy bill.

premises.text: Paying customers can receive ongoing and in-depth energy analysis for a low fee.
premises.evidence_span: we charge us a fee of less than £1 per day, per site.

premises.text: Energy Elephant has identified significant cost savings for its paying customers.
premises.evidence_span: we've identified cost savings of an average of 15% for our paying customers.

value.text: Businesses can make better energy decisions and reduce costs through effective energy data analysis.
value.evidence_span: helping them reduce their costs by thousands and reduce their environmental impacts.

notes: Consultant reliance and energy report usage are part of the same premise; they do not require separate changes.
